title: mlkem-nostd: ML-KEM (FIPS 203) in no_std Rust
description: A portable, no_std, allocation-free implementation of ML-KEM (FIPS 203) supporting ML-KEM-512, ML-KEM-768 and ML-KEM-1024. Includes official NIST ACVP known-answer tests, property tests, a byte-for-byte RustCrypto cross-check, dudect timing tests, Criterion benchmarks and a Docker reproducer. Research code; unaudited and not production ready.
